   105      H5O_attr_decode
   106   PURPOSE
   107      Decode a attribute message and return a pointer to a memory struct
   108          with the decoded information
   109   USAGE
   110      void *H5O_attr_decode(f, mesg_flags, p)
   111          H5F_t *f;               IN: pointer to the HDF5 file struct
   112          unsigned mesg_flags;    IN: Message flags to influence decoding
   113          const uint8_t *p;       IN: the raw information buffer
   114   RETURNS
   115      Pointer to the new message in native order on success, NULL on failure
   116   DESCRIPTION
   117          This function decodes the "raw" disk form of a attribute message
   118      into a struct in memory native format.  The struct is allocated within this
   119      function using malloc() and is returned to the caller.
   120  --------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   121  static void *
   122  H5O_attr_decode(H5F_t *f, H5O_t *open_oh, unsigned H5_ATTR_UNUSED mesg_flags,
   123      unsigned *ioflags, size_t H5_ATTR_UNUSED p_size, const uint8_t *p)
   124  {
   125      H5A_t               *attr = NULL;
   126      H5S_extent_t        *extent;        /*extent dimensionality information  */
   127      size_t              name_len;       /*attribute name length */
   128      size_t              dt_size;        /* Datatype size */
   129      hssize_t            sds_size;       /* Signed Dataspace size */
   130      hsize_t             ds_size;        /* Dataspace size */
   131      unsigned            flags = 0;      /* Attribute flags */
   132      H5A_t               *ret_value = NULL;      /* Return value */
   133
   134      FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI_NOINIT
   135
   136      /* check args */
   137      HDassert(f);
   138      HDassert(p);
   139
   140      if(NULL == (attr = H5FL_CALLOC(H5A_t)))
   141          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
   142
   143      if(NULL == (attr->shared = H5FL_CALLOC(H5A_shared_t)))
   144          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_FILE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "can't allocate shared attr structure")
   145
   146      /* Version number */
   147      attr->shared->version = *p++;
   148      if(attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_1 || attr->shared->version > H5O_ATTR_VERSION_LATEST)
   149          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTLOAD, NULL, "bad version number for attribute message")
   150
   151      /* Get the flags byte if we have a later version of the attribute */
   152      if(attr->shared->version >= H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   153          flags = *p++;
   154
   155          /* Check for unknown flag */
   156          if(flags & (unsigned)~H5O_ATTR_FLAG_ALL)
   157              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTLOAD, NULL, "unknown flag for attribute message")
   158      } /* end if */
   159      else
   160          p++;    /* Byte is unused when version<2 */

   162      /*
   163       * Decode the sizes of the parts of the attribute.  The sizes stored in
   164       * the file are exact but the parts are aligned on 8-byte boundaries.
   165       */
   166      UINT16DECODE(p, name_len); /*including null*/
   167      UINT16DECODE(p, attr->shared->dt_size);
   168      UINT16DECODE(p, attr->shared->ds_size);
   169
   170      /*
   171       * Decode the character encoding for the name for versions 3 or later,
   172       * as well as some reserved bytes.
   173       */

   179          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
   180
   181      /* Make an attempt to detect corrupted name or name length - HDFFV-10588 */
   182      if(name_len != (HDstrlen(attr->shared->name) + 1))
   183          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTDECODE, NULL, "attribute name has different length than stored length")
   184
   185      if(attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2)
   186          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(name_len);    /* advance the memory pointer */
   187      else

   192          ((flags & H5O_ATTR_FLAG_TYPE_SHARED) ? H5O_MSG_FLAG_SHARED : 0), ioflags, attr->shared->dt_size, p)))

   195          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->dt_size);

   212
   213      /* Release temporary extent information */
   214      extent = H5FL_FREE(H5S_extent_t, extent);
   215
   216      /* Default to entire dataspace being selected */
   217      if(H5S_select_all(attr->shared->ds, FALSE) < 0)
   218          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_DATASPACE, H5E_CANTSET, NULL, "unable to set all selection")

   222      else

   227          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTGET, NULL, "unable to get datatype size")

   230      if(0 == (dt_size = H5T_get_size(attr->shared->dt)))

   244      } /* end if */

   247         storage) or for the object from dense storage. */
   248      attr->shared->nrefs++;

   250      /* Set return value */
   251      ret_value = attr;
   252
   253  done:
   254      if(NULL == ret_value)
   255          if(attr) {
   256              /* Free any dynamically allocated items */
   257              if(attr->shared)
   258                  if(H5A__shared_free(attr) < 0)
   259                      HDONE_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTRELEASE, NULL, "can't release attribute info")
   260
   261              attr = H5FL_FREE(H5A_t, attr);
   262          } /* end if */
   263
   264      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   265  } /* end H5O_attr_decode() */

   268  /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
   269   NAME
   270      H5O_attr_encode
   271   PURPOSE
   272      Encode a simple attribute message
   273   USAGE
   274      herr_t H5O_attr_encode(f, p, mesg)
   275          H5F_t *f;         IN: pointer to the HDF5 file struct
   276          const uint8 *p;         IN: the raw information buffer
   277          const void *mesg;       IN: Pointer to the simple datatype struct
   278   RETURNS
   279      Non-negative on success/Negative on failure
   280   DESCRIPTION
   281          This function encodes the native memory form of the attribute
   282      message in the "raw" disk form.
   283  --------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   284  static herr_t
   285  H5O_attr_encode(H5F_t *f, uint8_t *p, const void *mesg)
   286  {
   287      const H5A_t *attr = (const H5A_t *) mesg;
   288      size_t      name_len;   /* Attribute name length */
   289      htri_t      is_type_shared;    /* Flag to indicate that a shared datatype is used for this attribute */
   290      htri_t      is_space_shared;   /* Flag to indicate that a shared dataspace is used for this attribute */
   291      unsigned    flags = 0;      /* Attribute flags */
   292      herr_t      ret_value = SUCCEED;      /* Return value */
   293
   294      FUNC_ENTER_NOAPI_NOINIT
   295
   296      /* check args */
   297      HDassert(f);
   298      HDassert(p);
   299      HDassert(attr);
   300
   301      /* Check whether datatype and dataspace are shared */
   302      if((is_type_shared = H5O_msg_is_shared(H5O_DTYPE_ID, attr->shared->dt)) < 0)
   303          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_OHDR, H5E_BADMESG, FAIL, "can't determine if datatype is shared")
   304
   305      if((is_space_shared = H5O_msg_is_shared(H5O_SDSPACE_ID, attr->shared->ds)) < 0)
   306          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_OHDR, H5E_BADMESG, FAIL, "can't determine if dataspace is shared")
   307
   308      /* Encode Version */
   309      *p++ = attr->shared->version;
   310
   311      /* Set attribute flags if version >1 */
   312      if(attr->shared->version >= H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   313          flags = (is_type_shared ? H5O_ATTR_FLAG_TYPE_SHARED : 0 );
   314          flags |= (is_space_shared ? H5O_ATTR_FLAG_SPACE_SHARED : 0);
   315          *p++ = (uint8_t)flags;    /* Set flags for attribute */
   316      } /* end if */
   317      else
   318          *p++ = 0; /* Reserved, for version <2 */
   319
   320      /*
   321       * Encode the lengths of the various parts of the attribute message. The
   322       * encoded lengths are exact but we pad each part except the data to be a
   323       * multiple of eight bytes (in the first version).
   324       */
   325      name_len = HDstrlen(attr->shared->name) + 1;
   326      UINT16ENCODE(p, name_len);
   327      UINT16ENCODE(p, attr->shared->dt_size);
   328      UINT16ENCODE(p, attr->shared->ds_size);
   329
   330      /* The character encoding for the attribute's name, in later versions */
   331      if(attr->shared->version >= H5O_ATTR_VERSION_3)
   332          *p++ = (uint8_t)attr->shared->encoding;
   333
   334      /* Write the name including null terminator */
   335      H5MM_memcpy(p, attr->shared->name, name_len);
   336      if(attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   337          /* Pad to the correct number of bytes */
   338          HDmemset(p + name_len, 0, H5O_ALIGN_OLD(name_len) - name_len);
   339          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(name_len);
   340      } /* end if */
   341      else
   342          p += name_len;
   343
   344      /* encode the attribute datatype */
   345      if((H5O_MSG_DTYPE->encode)(f, FALSE, p, attr->shared->dt) < 0)
   346          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTENCODE, FAIL, "can't encode attribute datatype")
   347
   348      if(attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   349          HDmemset(p + attr->shared->dt_size, 0, H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->dt_size) - attr->shared->dt_size);
   350          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->dt_size);
   351      } /* end if */
   352      else
   353          p += attr->shared->dt_size;
   354
   355      /* encode the attribute dataspace */
   356      if((H5O_MSG_SDSPACE->encode)(f, FALSE, p, &(attr->shared->ds->extent)) < 0)
   357          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTENCODE, FAIL, "can't encode attribute dataspace")
   358
   359      if(attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   360          HDmemset(p + attr->shared->ds_size, 0, H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->ds_size) - attr->shared->ds_size);
   361          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->ds_size);
   362      } /* end if */
   363      else
   364          p += attr->shared->ds_size;
   365
   366      /* Store attribute data.  If there's no data, store 0 as fill value. */
   367      if(attr->shared->data)
   368          H5MM_memcpy(p, attr->shared->data, attr->shared->data_size);
   369      else
   370          HDmemset(p, 0, attr->shared->data_size);
   371
   372  done:
   373      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value);
   374  } /* end H5O_attr_encode() */

# CFLAGS, CPPFLAGS and LDFLAGS are reserved for use by the script user.
# FLAGS brought from the hdf5 build are put in H5BLD_*FLAGS.

# User's CPPFLAGS and CFLAGS come after their H5BLD counterparts.  User's
# LDFLAGS come just before clibpath, user's LIBS come after $link_objs and
# before the hdf5 libraries in $link_args, followed by any external library
# paths and libraries from AM_LDFLAGS, LDFLAGS, AM_LIBS or LIBS carried in
# from the hdf5 build. The order of the flags is intended to give precedence
# to the user's flags.
H5BLD_CFLAGS=" -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer -gline-tables-only -DFUZZING_BUILD_MODE_UNSAFE_FOR_PRODUCTION -fsanitize=address -fsanitize-address-use-after-scope -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link"
H5BLD_CPPFLAGS=" -I/work/include "
H5BLD_LDFLAGS=" -L/work/lib "
H5BLD_LIBS="-lz -ldl -lm "

CC="${HDF5_CC:-$CCBASE}"
CLINKER="${HDF5_CLINKER:-$CLINKERBASE}"
CFLAGS="${HDF5_CFLAGS:-$CFLAGSBASE}"
CPPFLAGS="${HDF5_CPPFLAGS:-$CPPFLAGSBASE}"
LDFLAGS="${HDF5_LDFLAGS:-$LDFLAGSBASE}"
LIBS="${HDF5_LIBS:-$LIBSBASE}"

# If a static library is available, the default will be to use it.  If the only
# available library is shared, it will be used by default.  The user can
# override either default, although choosing an unavailable library will result
# in link errors.
STATIC_AVAILABLE="yes"
if test "${STATIC_AVAILABLE}" = "yes"; then
  USE_SHARED_LIB="${HDF5_USE_SHLIB:-no}"
else
  USE_SHARED_LIB="${HDF5_USE_SHLIB:-yes}"
fi
